content.rendered:
Mesenchymal Stem Cells (MSC)

MSC are multipotent cells that can differentiate into a variety of cell such as bone cells, cartilage cells, muscle cells, fat cells and nerve cells.

Our MSC derive from umbilical cord which is the youngest and most primitive MSCs.

MSCs have a great capacity for self-renewal, repairment, immuno regulations and anti-microbial effect.

builder_content:
Mesenchymal Stem Cells (MSC)

MSC are multipotent cells that can differentiate into a variety of cell such as bone cells, cartilage cells, muscle cells, fat cells and nerve cells.

Our MSC derive from umbilical cord which is the youngest and most primitive MSCs.

MSCs have a great capacity for self-renewal, repairment, immuno regulations and anti-microbial effect.
